meta.name: glycoengineering
meta.description: Analyze and engineer protein glycosylation. Scan sequences for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predict O-glycosylation hotspots, and access curated glycoengineering tools (NetOGlyc, GlycoShield, GlycoWorkbench). For glycoprotein engineering, therapeutic antibody optimization, and vaccine design.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 分析蛋白质糖基化位点,辅助抗体与疫苗设计
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你在做治疗性抗体或疫苗的糖基化设计。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze protein glycosylation sites to support antibody and vaccine design.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you engineer glycosylation for therapeutic antibodies or vaccines.

howto.what: 收到蛋白质序列后,它会扫描 N-糖基化位点(N-X-S/T)、按局部 S/T 密度预测 O-糖基化热点,并能给出增删糖基化位点的突变建议,同时推荐 NetOGlyc、GlycoWorkbench 等外部工具。
howto.when: 当用户提供蛋白序列并要求分析 N/O-糖基化位点、优化抗体 Fc 糖基化或设计疫苗糖基化盾时触发。

say.text: 帮我扫描这段蛋白序列里的 N-糖基化位点。
say.note: 会返回位点位置、基序和 ±3 残基上下文。

say.text: 把第 120 位的天冬酰胺突变成谷氨酰胺,消除这个糖基化位点。
预测这段序列的 O-糖基化热点。
say.note: 按局部 S/T 密度打分并列出候选位点。

howto.what_en: Given a protein sequence, it scans for N-glycosylation sequons (N-X-S/T), predicts O-glycosylation hotspots from local S/T density, and suggests mutations to add or remove glycosylation sites, while pointing to external tools such as NetOGlyc and GlycoWorkbench.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user provides a protein sequence and asks to analyze N/O-glycosylation sites, optimize antibody Fc glycosylation, or design vaccine glycan shields.

say_en.text: Scan this protein sequence for N-glycosylation sites.
say_en.note: Returns positions, motifs, and ±3 residue context.

say_en.text: Mutate asparagine at position 120 to glutamine to remove that glycosylation site.
Predict O-glycosylation hotspots in this sequence.
say_en.note: Scores by local S/T density and lists candidates.
